summary_en: Meiwa Corporation reaffirmed its capital cost and stock price-conscious management policy for fiscal 2026. The company targets ROE of 10% or above and PBR of 1.0 or higher through its medium-term business plan PI 2028, to be achieved by improving expected growth rates and reducing cost of equity, alongside business portfolio transformation, M&A, talent investment, capital discipline, and ESG initiatives.
title_en: Response Toward Realization of Management with Awareness of Cost of Capital and Stock Price (Fiscal 2026)
translation_en_brief:
On September 30, 2026, Meiwa Corporation's Board of Directors reaffirmed and updated the company's capital cost and stock price-conscious management policy originally disclosed on October 2, 2025. The policy aims to improve ROE alongside enhancing expected growth rates and reducing the cost of equity to improve PER. The company targets ROE of 10% or higher and PBR of 1.0 or higher through achievement of the medium-term business plan "PI 2028."

To realize these targets, the company will pursue six strategic initiatives: (1) business portfolio transformation and non-linear growth through M&A and business investments; (2) investment in value-creating talent and strengthening organizational capability to support challenges; (3) rigorous capital discipline with stock price awareness; (4) nurturing of businesses to become future profit pillars; (5) strengthening of ESG and sustainability activities; and (6) improving brand recognition and penetrating the company's growth narrative with investors and stakeholders.
